output.title: Renovated 5-Bedroom Villa with Garden and Terrace in Quiet Strassen
output.description:
This detached villa offers 280 m² of living space across two levels, situated in a tranquil residential area of Strassen. The property features a traditional Luxembourg architectural style with a white plaster facade and a pitched slate roof, complemented by an established mature garden that enhances privacy and outdoor living opportunities.

Inside, the living room is defined by high ceilings and parquet flooring, with a wood-burning fireplace creating a warm focal point. Patio doors provide direct access to the garden, inviting natural light and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The villa's renovated kitchen is designed with shaker cabinetry, a granite worktop, and a central island with seating, equipped with a double oven to accommodate sociable cooking and family gatherings.

The garden extends with a stone-paved patio and mature trees arranged in a naturalistic style, enjoying a south-west exposure that emphasizes enjoyment throughout the day. Five bedrooms include a master suite with fitted wardrobes and views over the garden, ensuring restful privacy. The property also benefits from a cellar, a parking area, and a terrace, making it a complete offering for residential comfort.

Strassen itself is known for a village character combined with the convenience of good motorway links and accessible services. It hosts reputable schools, contributing to its standing as a well-regarded suburban municipality west of Luxembourg City.

highlights.text: Detached villa with traditional Luxembourg style
Fully equipped kitchen with central island and double oven
Established mature garden with south-west exposure
